product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™4K60 HDBaseT™ Extender with HDMI® & ARC Support Up to 70mExtend Ultra HD Video and Premium Audio Effortlessly Across Long Distances with Advanced HDR, Control, and ARC CapabilitiesEnjoy seamless AV connectivity with the Blackbird 4K60 HDBaseT Extender, purpose‑built for reliable, professional‑grade signal transmission over long distances. Supporting HDMI 2.0b and HDCP™ 2.2, this powerful extender delivers crisp 4K resolution at 60 Hz with vibrant colors and advanced HDR formats, including Dolby Vision™ and HDR10+ for lifelike visuals.Transmit HDMI signals, bi‑directional IR control, ARC (Audio Return Channel), and RS‑232 commands up to 230 feet (70 meters) using a single Cat5e/6 cable. Versatile and robust, this solution is ideal for video conferencing, multimedia distribution, digital signage, and complex AV installations. With a wide 18 Gbps bandwidth, advanced EDID® management, and convenient bi‑directional PoC (Power‑over‑Cable) support, installation is simple and efficient. Its compact, durable metal enclosure ensures easy mounting easy in any environment.Benefit from rich audio support for premium formats like Dolby True HD®, DTS‑HD Master Audio®, and ARC compatibility with Dolby® 5.1, DTS® 5.1, and PCM 2.0. Every kit includes all the necessary hardware for a fast, hassle‑free setup.
